name: 86 Chaos 16.0.23 Compact Professional UI Refinement
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.23 Compact Professional UI Refinement
notes: Refines the existing dark 86 Chaos interface into a tighter, more professional operations-console layout.
Adds shared compact UI tokens for page spacing, cards, controls, tables, modals, and mobile containment.
Tightens the app shell, page headers, toolbars, dashboards, forms, tables, and System Administrator panels without changing workflows.
Keeps the Schedule Builder assignment controls directly above the calendar grid while reducing wasted desktop space.
Adds mobile containment rules for long IDs, tables, drawers, modals, filenames, and action rows to prevent body-level horizontal overflow.
releaseNotes: Desktop spacing, card padding, toolbar gaps, form controls, table rows, and modal spacing now use compact shared density tokens.
Schedule Builder controls remain directly above the calendar grid and are tightened for faster assignment workflows.
System Administrator cards, logs, destructive-action panels, badges, and technical identifiers are constrained for a denser console feel.
Mobile layouts add min-width, wrapping, containment, and internal-scroll safeguards for tables, IDs, URLs, files, and button rows without hiding overflow as the only fix.
86Voice and mobile tap targets remain usable while desktop controls become smaller and more refined.
No Firebase wiring, credentials, data structures, rules, permissions, calculations, exports, or operational workflows were changed.
